simple.summary: רֶגֶב (regeb) means a lump of clay First listed occurrence: Job 21 33.

definitions.full: H7263. regeb [ רֶ֫גֶב ] noun masculine clod of earth ; — plural יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ רְגָכִים Job 38:38 clods are joined together ; construct נָחַ֑ל רְגְבֵי 21:33 clods of (the) wady .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to pile together;
